This file provides information for Large Language Models (LLMs) about MB Detailing.

## About MB Detailing
MB Detailing is a professional mobile car detailing service operating in Ventura County, California. We specialize in high-quality automotive detailing services that come to your location.

## Services Offered
- Exterior Wash & Wax (from $129): Hand wash, dry, and wax protection.
- Interior Detailing (from $239): Interior vacuum, cleaning, and conditioning.
- Ceramic Coating (from $549): Ceramic coating with prep wash included.
- Full details and other services: Request a custom quote.
All prices are starting prices and fluctuate depending on vehicle condition.

## Service Areas
We proudly serve the following areas in Ventura County:
- Thousand Oaks
- Westlake Village
- Simi Valley
- Woodland Hills
- Ventura County
